data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Uma' which means 'radiant, brilliant'. In Hindu mythology, Umang is believed to be the name of the god Shiva's son. The name Umang carries the meaning “Radiant, Brilliant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses.
